ad_info.structure_source: library format F34 (Antes y después real con banda de oferta y precio por unidad), winning structure mv-02
ad_info.reference_style: Premium real-photo before/after supplement ad on a cream background with a big serif headline, two rounded photo cards, a large standing bottle, a diagonal brush-stroke band and two info boxes
ad_info.angle_used: Objeción de confianza (gancho de oferta sin precio: pagas al recibir, rinde un mes, sin suscripción)
ad_info.ad_format: Single Image Ad - before/after with offer band

global_identity.color_palette: Lemon yellow #F5E13A (highlights, label color), amber brown #9A4F12 (glass and warm accents), deep cocoa #2B1A10 (headline, pills, brush band, dark box), warm cream #FFF6DC (background and light box), white #FFFFFF (text on dark), gold #C9962B (thin lines and details). No red: there is no price in this image.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, premium direct-response supplement ad with real photography of a young Colombian woman and the real amber dropper bottle with its yellow label.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Warm, honest and calm: soft window light, cream and gold tones, trustworthy and elegant.
global_identity.graphic_language: Thin gold horizontal lines, rounded photo cards, cocoa pills for ANTES/DESPUÉS, one round arrow badge, a rough diagonal cocoa brush stroke, two rounded rectangular boxes; no logos, no medical imagery.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a heavy high-contrast serif (like Playfair Display Black) in deep cocoa #2B1A10; subtitle and all other text in Poppins (SemiBold to ExtraBold), uppercase where indicated.

creative_objective: Break the trust objection of a thin 20-34 year old Colombian woman who already wasted money on gummies: show a believable real before/after of her glutes and hips (flat in baggy grey leggings at home vs rounder and lifted in blue jeans on the street, another day) next to the real bottle, and replace the price block of the structure with three risk-free facts: pay on delivery, one bottle lasts one month, no subscription.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Serif product name headline at the top. 2) The before/after photo pair on the left with the bottle on the right. 3) The cocoa brush band 'Pagas al recibir' bottom-left. 4) The two info boxes bottom-right.
art_direction.composition_style: Three horizontal zones exactly like the structure: top 25 % title block between gold lines; middle 50 % split 60/40 (two photo cards left, tall bottle right); bottom 25 % split (diagonal brush band left, two boxes right, under the bottle).
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Generous cream margins (about 4 % on every side), even 2 % gap between the two photo cards, the round arrow badge overlapping the gap at mid-height, bottle base aligned just above the boxes.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft diffused window light from the left in both photos and on the bottle; gentle contact shadow under the bottle; subtle warm vignette on the cream background.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Cream background with faint diagonal light streaks. TOP 25 %: a thin gold horizontal line on each side (the reference brand logo with leaf is removed and that space stays as background), a huge one-line serif headline in a dark color centered, and below it a one-line wide-spaced uppercase subtitle flanked by thin gold lines. MIDDLE 50 %: on the left 60 %, two side-by-side rounded-corner real photo cards of the same body area (before left, after right), each with a dark rounded pill label at its top edge ('ANTES' / 'DESPUÉS'), and a dark circle with a white right arrow overlapping the gap between them; on the right 40 %, one large dropper bottle standing upright, about 60 % of the canvas height, from the middle zone down into the bottom zone. BOTTOM 25 %: on the left, a rough diagonal dark brush-stroke band with big white and gold text (the offer); on the right, under the bottle, two rounded boxes side by side separated by a thin vertical line (a light cream/gold box and a dark box). No CTA button, no stars, no bottom strip.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement ad on a warm cream #FFF6DC background with very faint diagonal light streaks and a soft warm vignette. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. TOP ZONE (0-25 % of the canvas height): no logo; a thin gold #C9962B horizontal line on the left and on the right at about 8 % height. Centered at about 13 % height, one huge line of heavy high-contrast serif type (Playfair Display Black style) in deep cocoa #2B1A10 reading 'VITALDROPS', spanning about 85 % of the width. Under it, at about 21 % height, one line of wide letter-spaced uppercase Poppins SemiBold in deep cocoa reading 'TU RITUAL DIARIO PARA TUS CURVAS', with a short thin gold line at each side. MIDDLE ZONE (25-75 %): on the left 60 % of the width, two equal tall rounded-corner photo cards side by side (corner radius about 3 % of the canvas), 2 % gap between them, each with a deep cocoa #2B1A10 rounded pill on its top edge with white Poppins ExtraBold uppercase text: 'ANTES' on the left card, 'DESPUÉS' on the right card. Both are real photographs of the same slim young Colombian woman (light-brown skin, real skin texture with pores and fine hair, no retouching), seen in strict side profile facing right, camera at hip height, 50 mm lens, framed from the waist to mid-thigh so the glutes, hips and upper legs fill the card. BEFORE card: at home, beige wall and a sofa edge softly blurred behind, cool soft window light from the left; she wears baggy heather-grey cotton leggings and a plain white cropped tee; her glutes look flat and low, her hip line is almost straight from waist to thigh, her thighs are thin and straight; her right hand pinches and pulls the loose grey fabric at the back of the seat about a fist away from her body, showing the empty gap and a slack fold of fabric under the glute. AFTER card, clearly another day: outdoors on a sunny city sidewalk with a warm blurred brick wall behind, warm late-morning sunlight from the left; she wears fitted mid-blue high-waisted denim jeans with visible stitching and back pockets sitting high, and a black fitted tank top tucked in; her glutes are rounder, fuller and lifted, her hips clearly wider than her waist, her thighs fuller and toned, the jeans filled with no loose fabric; relaxed confident posture, one hand resting on her hip. Between the two cards, centered at mid-height, a deep cocoa circle (about 8 % of the canvas width) with a thin white border and a white right-pointing arrow. On the right 40 % of the width, standing upright and facing the camera, the product: ONE amber-brown glass Boston-round dropper bottle with ribbed matte black collar and tall matte black rubber bulb, about 58 % of the canvas height, from about 28 % down to about 80 % height, straight-on with a very slight 5-degree turn, the wrap-around lemon-yellow-to-white label fully facing the viewer and legible: lowercase black 'amua', big bold white 'VITALDROPS' with thin yellow outline, 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small outlined circles, 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)'; dark amber liquid visible above the label, glossy glass with a soft vertical window reflection, soft contact shadow on the cream surface; matte finish, no rainbow, no lens flare. BOTTOM ZONE (75-100 %): on the left 50 %, a rough diagonal brush stroke in deep cocoa #2B1A10 with dry-brush ragged edges, tilted about 8 degrees upward to the right; inside it a rounded badge with a 3 px white border containing large white Poppins ExtraBold text 'Pagas al recibir', with a thin gold #C9962B underline. On the right, under the bottle, two rounded rectangular boxes side by side separated by a thin vertical gold line: the left box warm cream with a gold #C9962B border and gold sheen, deep cocoa Poppins ExtraBold uppercase text '1 FRASCO RINDE 1 MES' on two lines; the right box solid deep cocoa with white Poppins ExtraBold uppercase text 'SIN SUSCRIPCIÓN' on two lines. No prices, no numbers other than those written, no stars, no logo, no button.

final_generation_exclusions: No brand logo, leaf icon or wordmark other than the bottle's own label.
No price, currency symbol, strikethrough, discount or quantity offer.
No stars, reviews, testimonials, names, seals, certificates or registration numbers.
No underwear or swimwear: only leggings and jeans.
No second bottle, no drops, capsules or pills, no yellow '60ml' circle beside the bottle.
Do not mirror or redesign the bottle label.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
